name: Qwen3-TTS (Alibaba)
blurb: Apache-2.0. 3-second rapid cloning, strong emotion control, plus VoiceDesign: describe a voice in plain words and get it.

models.name: 1.7B VoiceDesign — voice from a text description

params.label: Voice description
params.help: E.g. 'A warm, deep male narrator voice, slow and calm'. Only used by the VoiceDesign model.

params.label: Preset speaker
params.help: Nine official Qwen voices. Aiden/Ryan are native English; each speaker can speak any supported language.

params.label: Delivery instruction
params.help: Natural-language direction, e.g. 'Speak slowly, warmly, and with restrained excitement.'

params.label: Fast timbre-only clone
params.help: Skips reference transcription. Faster setup, but full ICL cloning usually preserves style and identity better.

params.label: Seed (0 = random)
params.help: Fix a seed to reproduce a take you liked.

params.label: Temperature
params.help: Sampling randomness. Lower = more consistent, higher = more varied takes.

params.label: Top-p
params.help: Nucleus sampling cutoff. Lower = safer, more predictable delivery.

params.label: Top-k
params.help: Limits each sampling step to the most likely tokens. 50 is Qwen's documented quality default.

params.label: Repetition guard
params.help: Reduces repeated syllables or phrases. Raise gently; high values can hurt naturalness.

params.label: Pitch (semitones)
params.help: Shift the voice up/down, keeping the speaker's timbre (TD-PSOLA). ±2–4 stays natural.

params.label: Formant / character
params.help: Changes apparent vocal-tract size independent of pitch: + = smaller/younger, − = bigger/deeper character.

params.label: Intonation range
params.help: How far the pitch swings around its median: 0 = monotone, 1 = as generated, 1.5+ = extra expressive.

params.label: Clarity
params.help: Speech-intelligibility EQ: less mud, more presence and air. Subtle at 0.3, radio-voice at 1.

params.label: Loudness normalize (0/1)
params.help: Match every take to a consistent loudness (-18 LUFS).
